rationale: the seeded executable validator never compares result_transaction.state to the schema enum
strengthened_errors: $.result_transaction.state: 'DEFINITELY_NOT_A_STATE' is not a declared transaction state

rationale: a COMPLETED result may claim a merely RESERVED transaction
strengthened_errors: $.result_transaction.state: RESERVED is incoherent with obzio_state COMPLETED

rationale: custody timestamps are checked for presence but never for order
strengthened_errors: $.result_transaction.verified_at: fully read-back result verified before it was committed

rationale: only artifact_id uniqueness is enforced, so one path can be counted twice
artifact content URIs are never tied to the claimed result commit
a manifest may be located without any digest before the committed states
